title: Kalshi partners with Kodex to strengthen law enforcement cooperation and protect customer data
summary: Kalshi partners with Kodex to give law enforcement a verified channel for subpoenas and warrants, speeding responses while protecting customer data.
body_markdown:
Today, Kalshi, a federally regulated financial exchange, is proud to announce its partnership with Kodex. Kodex is the preeminent provider in the Law Enforcement SaaS space, building secure solutions for companies to receive and respond to legal records requests and warrants. This partnership will strengthen and streamline how Kalshi receives and responds to law enforcement requests.


​Through the Kodex platform, agencies can submit subpoenas, warrants, and other record requests to Kalshi while accessing the broader Kodex network. Kodex serves more than 15,000 government agencies and 160,000 verified investigators worldwide. Kodex verifies investigators' identities before requests reach Kalshi, providing a secure, efficient process while helping safeguard sensitive customer information and meeting industry standards for response procedures.


“Kalshi aims to be a partner with law enforcement. We are confident that Kodex will improve our efficiency in responding to subpoenas and law enforcement requests,” said Lauren Bowman, Enforcement Counsel at Kalshi and a former federal prosecutor.


The partnership builds on Kalshi’s commitment to working collaboratively with law enforcement and maintaining rigorous standards as the prediction market industry continues to grow. Kalshi’s team includes professionals with extensive federal law enforcement experience, including Bowman; Sean Fern, a former federal prosecutor and FBI agent who leads the company’s anti-money laundering efforts; and Tyler Neff, a former FBI Staff Operations Specialist and member of Kalshi’s surveillance team.


“When I was at the FBI, the hardest part of getting records was often figuring out who to ask,” said Matt Donahue, co-founder and CEO of Kodex. “Prediction markets are new to a lot of investigators, so Kalshi is making it simple for them to get in touch. Every request they get through Kodex comes from a verified investigator, which means their team can move fast and trust what they’re answering. Kalshi’s users are better protected when the people investigating fraud can get answers quickly.”


​By centralizing requests through Kodex, Kalshi can improve response times, strengthen requester verification, meet industry standards, and provide investigators with a clear channel for submitting legal process.


Law enforcement agencies can submit requests to Kalshi through its Kodex portal
